scenes.captionText: Every public chain is a glass ledger. Your balance, your counterparty, your timing.
captionLines: Every public chain is a glass ledger. Your balance, your counterparty, your timing.

scenes.captionText: All of it readable, forever. Fluton keeps a different book: it holds no balances, only notes.
captionLines: All of it readable, forever. Fluton keeps a different book: it holds no balances, only notes.

scenes.captionText: Each note is one sealed commitment, a leaf in a single append-only tree.
captionLines: Each note is one sealed commitment, a leaf in a single append-only tree.

scenes.captionText: Spend it and it becomes three, and value is conserved: what goes in, plus what crosses the boundary, equals what comes out.
captionLines: Spend it and it becomes three, and value is conserved: what goes in, plus what crosses the boundary, equals what comes out.

scenes.captionText: All the chain learns is a nullifier, proof that a note is spent, never which one.
captionLines: All the chain learns is a nullifier, proof that a note is spent, never which one.

scenes.captionText: Recipient, amount, fee and ciphertexts are bound into one hash, so nobody can retarget your transaction.
captionLines: Recipient, amount, fee and ciphertexts are bound into one hash, so nobody can retarget your transaction.

scenes.captionText: Only the net amount crossing the pool is public.
captionLines: Only the net amount crossing the pool is public.

scenes.captionText: Deposits and withdrawals show their size. Everything inside stays sealed.
captionLines: Deposits and withdrawals show their size. Everything inside stays sealed.
